experiences.method_family: Hodge-persistence plus semiregularity-detector inference for witness lifting
experiences.failure_mode: When detector faithfulness is absent on the geometric obstruction directions actually generated by the branch, Hodge persistence can place an obstruction in the detector kernel but cannot imply that the geometric obstruction vanishes.
residual_signature: base Hodge compatibility survives while witness-lifting conclusion is not certified
geometric obstruction may occupy a nontrivial detector kernel
full semiregularity is sufficient in known controls but may be stronger than branch-specific necessity
broken_assumptions: cohomological/Hodge compatibility detects every geometric obstruction direction relevant to the chosen witness
scope_conditions: the warning concerns inference from Hodge persistence to geometric witness lifting through a semiregularity-type detector
it does not assert that non-semiregular cycles fail to deform
it applies only when no independent proof excludes detector-kernel directions from the branch-generated obstruction set
competing_diagnoses: the branch may generate only a proper subspace disjoint from the detector kernel, making full semiregularity unnecessarily strong
the detector may need a different witness category or derived obstruction object in higher codimension
higher Artin orders may generate new obstruction directions even if first order avoids the kernel
experiences.selected_diagnosis: The parent route is missing an independently defined branch-generated obstruction envelope; without it, replacing full semiregularity by 'injective on relevant obstructions' is circular.
experiences.falsifier_or_attempt: Parent hostile calibration removed detector injectivity and asked what Hodge persistence alone implies about a geometric obstruction.
experiences.observed_result: Only membership in the detector kernel is justified; vanishing of the geometric obstruction is not justified without branch-specific faithfulness.
local_repair_attempts: open H4d1a to construct B_{T,m} independently from branch geometry and prove containment plus detector injectivity there
require a strict-weaker non-semiregular calibration before treating branch-restricted faithfulness as useful
